s04ev7qv.sourceDescription: Looking for a fibre optic tree that looks just as good in the day as it does lit up in the evening? We've just the tree for you. azkc54hx.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree 75 cm Wide - Green - 150 cm
azkc54hx.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree 75 cm Wide - Green - 150 cm
azkc54hx.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree is a pristine embodiment of contemporary style blended with classic holiday spirit. Designed to bring life and light to any room or outdoor shelter, its lush green branches made from durable PVC and PE offer a realistic and lasting appearance. Perfect for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree stands as a centerpiece of seasonal décor, effortlessly transforming any living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland, suitable for gatherings, celebrations, or quiet family moments. Quality Materials: Crafted from a durable combination of PVC and PE, this tree stands out for its ability to mimic the natural look and feel of a genuine Christmas tree, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your seasonal décor for years. Sturdy Construction: Supported by a robust iron stand, the tree remains firm and stable, providing a sound foundation for your holiday ornaments and lights, thus safeguarding your seasonal decorations from tilting or toppling over. Modern Design: This tree adopts a sleek, modern design with minimal ornamentation, making it a versatile choice for spaces that value simplicity without sacrificing festive spirit. This design exudes timeless elegance, ensuring it complements various décor styles seamlessly. Seasonal Versatility: Perfect for both living rooms and sheltered outdoor areas, this tree engages the holiday spirit in diverse environments. Its adjustable features provide the flexibility to fit within different spatial setups, making it truly adaptable. Easy Maintenance: The tree comes with straightforward assembly instructions, requiring just a screwdriver and the efforts of two people, making it a convenient choice for those looking to decorate with minimal fuss during the busy holiday rush. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC, pe and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Durable Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hv8nqvmg.sourceDescription: Struggling to create a standout festive display? Don't let tangled setups and dull decor hold you back. This Outsunny inflatable snowman offers an easy solution—it self-inflates in moments, glowing with dazzling LED lights. The scene instantly draws attention, bringing smiles and seasonal joy to everyone who passes by. ● Stands an impressive 6 ft tall, creating a cheerful centerpiece for yards ● Two LED light sets and a colourful flashing light bring a festive glow ● Self-inflates in moments with the built-in blower for quick setup ● Includes ground stakes, tethers and sandbags to keep it securely anchored outdoors ● Made of water-resistant polyester, ensuring durability for outdoor use ● Colour: White, Brown, Black, Red ● Material: Polyester Fabric ● Overall Dimension: 157W x 95D x 183H cm ● Power Cable Length: 1.8 m ● Blower: DC 12V / 0.85A ● Input: 220-240V, 50/60Hz ● Output: DC 12V, 1A ● Waterproof Rating: IP44 ● Item Label: 84J-122V70WT Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
